text: [excited] Your server crashes! [gasp] Does the customer's order disappear? [cheerful] Not if you use a queue. [warmly] Think of it as a waiting line for work. [calm] The queue keeps the order safe while a worker gets ready. [pauses] [authoritative] But here is the crucial part: receiving a job is not the same as finishing it.
